title: Resolve Pixelscan no-proxy fingerprint inconsistency
description: Pixelscan no-proxy release smoke on invisible-browser-manager:automation-console-redaction reached pixelscan.net/fingerprint-check but reported 'Your Browser Fingerprint is inconsistent'. Low-sensitive diagnostic showed the actual status line plus cards for Browser, Location, Fingerprint, WebRTC IP Address, Timezone from JS, HardwareConcurency, Language, Languages from Javascript, Accept-Language header, and Hardware. IPhey home loaded as Trustworthy, but /leaks returned an edge error page, so the Pixelscan/IPhey gate remains incomplete. Investigate the root cause without storing screenshots, cookies, local storage, headers, tokens, IP values, profile dir contents, or full page text.
acceptance_criteria: No-proxy Pixelscan/IPhey external smoke can be rerun from a temporary Docker manager and proves no IP/timezone/language/WebRTC/hardware/software high-risk inconsistency; diagnostic evidence is low-sensitive only; release checklist and cbim-23h.1 notes are updated; full quality gates are rerun if code changes.
notes:
2026-06-03 root-cause diagnostic: reran no-proxy Pixelscan in temporary Docker managers with low-sensitive DOM extraction only. Pixelscan status bar remained error/inconsistent, but DOM showed the only failed checker card was PXLSCN-FINGERPRINT-MASKING with text 'Masking detected Fingerprint'. Proxy, Location, Bot check, language/timezone/WebRTC, and WebGL display values did not show high-risk mismatch; minimal profile without explicit gpu_vendor/gpu_renderer/hardware_concurrency still failed on the same fingerprint masking card. Docker image invisible_playwright is 0.1.0; bundled Firefox application.ini reports Version=150.0.1 and BuildID=20260521160037, while Manager intentionally exposes Firefox 149 to match BrowserScan detectable kernel. Current evidence points to underlying patched Firefox / zoom.stealth.* seed-based fingerprint masking, not Manager proxy/GeoIP/language/WebRTC or explicit GPU/hardware pin. Temporary A/B attempts to override stealth seed/canvas noise caused launch failure and are not production candidates. Gate remains incomplete; no screenshots, cookies, local storage, full headers, tokens, IP values, profile dirs, full page text, full URL params, font lists, WebRTC candidates, or audit metadata were stored.
2026-06-03 observability follow-up: added low-sensitive Firefox identity fields to protected GET /api/diagnostics runtime payload so future Pixelscan/BrowserScan troubleshooting can compare Manager managed UA version with bundled Firefox application.ini version and BuildID without entering containers or exposing full UA/path/profile data. New fields: managed_user_agent_version, firefox_binary_version, firefox_binary_build_id. Frontend System diagnostics now displays Managed UA, Firefox binary, and Firefox BuildID. Guardrails keep diagnostics on count helpers and assert full UA/profile id/paths/proxy/token/automation steps are not exposed. Verified focused backend diagnostics tests, SystemDiagnosticsPage test, frontend api.test, and frontend build. This does not fix Pixelscan fingerprint masking; cbim-23h.6 remains incomplete.
2026-06-03 next-phase goal assignment: keep cbim-23h.6 as the primary release blocker and continue with a wider stability-convergence scope. Investigate bottom-layer invisible_playwright / patched Firefox prefs and zoom.stealth.* behavior for the Pixelscan PXLSCN-FINGERPRINT-MASKING failure; add low-sensitive diagnostics and tests where they reduce runtime/profile/launch uncertainty; preserve redaction guardrails for automation, proxy, profile, WebRTC, headers, screenshots, and audit metadata; rerun BrowserScan/BrowserLeaks/CreepJS/Pixelscan/IPhey and proxy-country smoke gates before closing. cbim-23h.1 remains blocked until no-proxy Pixelscan/IPhey acceptance evidence is low-sensitive and actionable.
2026-06-03 diagnostics package-version follow-up: verified local .venv and invisible-browser-manager:automation-console-redaction image both report invisible_playwright 0.1.8, correcting the earlier stale 0.1.0 diagnostic note. Added low-sensitive GET /api/diagnostics runtime field invisible_playwright_version and frontend System diagnostics Engine package row so future Pixelscan/IPhey troubleshooting can compare Manager code, installed invisible_playwright package, managed UA version, Firefox application.ini version, and BuildID without entering containers or exposing package paths, full UA, profile ids, profile dirs, proxy data, headers, cookies, tokens, automation steps, or page content. Verified RED/GREEN focused diagnostics tests, then full backend pytest (508 passed), full frontend vitest (16 files / 221 tests passed), and frontend build. This improves observability only; PXLSCN-FINGERPRINT-MASKING remains unresolved and cbim-23h.6 stays in_progress.
2026-06-03 automation page_ref redaction guardrail: found Automation task redacted responses and persisted steps still trusted caller-provided page_ref even though the contract only allows page indexes or UUID page ids. Added sanitizer so page_ref is preserved only when it is an ASCII decimal page index or canonical UUID; all other strings/non-strings are stored and returned as low-sensitive invalid. This prevents URL/query/fragment/token/path text in page_ref from reaching task storage or create/get/list/cancel/run responses, while keeping normal page index and UUID page_id flows intact. Verified RED on sensitive page_ref response leakage, GREEN focused automation redaction/page_id tests, full backend pytest (509 passed), full frontend vitest (16 files / 221 tests passed), frontend build, and git diff --check. This tightens automation redaction only; Pixelscan PXLSCN-FINGERPRINT-MASKING remains unresolved and cbim-23h.6 stays in_progress.
2026-06-03 stealth pref diagnostics follow-up: added low-sensitive runtime diagnostics for the current invisible_playwright stealth pref surface. GET /api/diagnostics runtime now returns stealth_pref_count and normalized stealth_pref_categories only; raw zoom.stealth.* keys, hw_seed, seed values, pref values, WebRTC host IPs, font lists, package paths, profile dirs, proxy data, headers, cookies, local storage, automation payloads, viewer tokens, and runtime service tokens are not exposed. Local .venv helper reports 29 stealth prefs across audio/canvas/debugger/fingerprint/font/hardware/screen/storage/timezone/voices/webgl/webrtc categories; backend test suite also covers safe None/[] degradation when only the test double package is available. Verified RED/GREEN focused diagnostics tests, full backend pytest (511 passed), full frontend vitest (16 files / 221 tests passed), frontend build, and git diff --check. This improves Pixelscan PXLSCN-FINGERPRINT-MASKING observability only; the no-proxy Pixelscan/IPhey gate remains unresolved and cbim-23h.6 stays in_progress.
